categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Touches src/chain.h to alter the struct layout of CBlockIndex, which represents the in-memory block index.
categories.rationale: Reordering CBlockIndex members saves 8 bytes of padding per instance, reducing memory consumption by roughly 8MB over ~1M blocks. While valid and cleanly measurable, this is a minor memory optimization that does not resolve any critical resource exhaustion or validation bottleneck.
